verdict.rationale: There's evidence of an official Intuit MCP server (quickbooks-gh-3 showing 145 tools covering the QBO API, plus quickbooks-probe-3 confirming official docs at developer.intuit.com) supporting agent connectivity via MCP. However, this is a developer-facing API integration rather than a core QuickBooks Online product feature, and there's no first-party marketing/docs page or hands-on independent corroboration of setup/usage. missing for 10: official first-party documentation/announcement directly from Intuit marketing or main docs, independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working, details on authentication and deployment for end users.
